note: Shōkai test vectors for spec v0.5.0 (the v0.3.0 vectors unchanged, plus `v050` for C230–C254; SPEC Appendix A.2; inbound_door: §10). TEST KEYS ONLY, derived from public labels. Path in the repository: conformance/test-vectors.json.

key_derivation.ed25519: seed = SHA-256(UTF-8("shokai-demo-seed:" + label)); the 32-byte seed is the RFC 8032 private key
key_derivation.p256_passkey: d = SHA-256(UTF-8("shokai-demo-passkey:" + label)) read as a big-endian integer (the P-256 private scalar)

ed25519.signed_bytes: the 32 raw SHA-256 bytes of JCS(payload) (digest_raw_hex)

passkey.rp_rule: v0.2.4: webauthn.rp_id is REQUIRED and bound by rpIdHash; when the owner's card is known its owner_binding.rp_id MUST equal it; with no card known, verify against webauthn.rp_id

allowance_status.rule: v0.2.4 (G7, §5.2): platform-signed (Ed25519 test key 'test-vector-platform'); fresh while now < next_update and next_update - issued_at <= 1 h (D12)

did_jwk.rule: base64url (no padding) of UTF-8 JSON with members kty, crv, x, y in that order, no whitespace; compare keys by parsed JWK, never by string

timestamps.rule: RFC 3339, UTC 'Z', whole seconds; ±300 s clock skew tolerated on not-before / expiry checks

budget_periods.rule: consecutive windows anchored at allowance.valid_from (UTC); P1M adds calendar months, clamped to month end

inbound_door.rule: v0.2.9 (§10): offers are data. Normalisation strips and counts invisible code points (U+00AD, U+180E, U+200B–U+200F, U+202A–U+202E, U+2060–U+2064, U+2066–U+2069, U+FEFF, U+E0000–U+E007F); in format html it removes comments and elements hidden by styling (display:none, visibility:hidden, font-size:0, opacity:0, large negative offsets, the hidden attribute, aria-hidden=true, text colour equal to its background, white on the default white page), keeps them for the owner, drops other tags and collapses whitespace.

passkey_profile.note: v0.3.0-rc4 owner signing profile (Appendix A.1, C195). Key: the passkey vector's key (label key_derivation.labels.passkey). Single-item cases sign jcs_digest.digest; verify each with rp_id = passkey.rp_id and compare the outcome with expect (true = verifies; otherwise the reason a verifier refuses it). Reason codes are the reference's and are informative; the true/false outcome is normative.

representative_key_encoding.note: Review 4 R4-07 (SPEC §2.1): representative_key.public_key has one encoding, base64url without padding of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 key (43 characters). ijson_c284.note: SPEC §2.2 C284 (review 6 R6-05): each `text` is a body exactly as received; `expect` is accept or reject. Numbers: the token, parsed to the nearest double and re-serialised per RFC 8785 §3.2.2.3, must denote the same value.
